title: Record header summary chip draws the progress bar for a percent field whose percentDisplay is plain
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxWPiQYXSf1jxGbN3W

Filing gate ①, Source: fleet. Out-of-scope finding of the #35798 dev (os-dev-report 7062347222), routed to a filing-gate pass by the L1 review of PR #36058 (7062519794). Dedupe: `percentDisplay chip` 4 hits, `percentDisplay summary` 7 hits, `summary chip bar plain` 57 hits; the only open card among them is #35798, which fixes the chip's formula arm and closes with PR #36058, not this; #27973 and #28255 (closed) delivered `percentDisplay` for the list cell.

## What happens (rendered at `origin/main` 615d9954)
The spec says `percentDisplay` governs a `percent` field (or a `percent` formula) wherever it is displayed read-only, "list cells, record page", and `plain` = "the percentage as text alone, with no bar" (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, the `percentDisplay` describe).

The summary chip beside the record title (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, the `effectiveSummaryFields` chips) never reads it. Its percent arm sets `percentValue` from `summaryChipPercentPoints` (about l.1442-1443) and, whenever `percentValue !== null`, draws the bar track and fill (about l.1536-1555). `grep -nw percentDisplay` in DetailView.tsx finds nothing. `PercentCellRenderer` honours it (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx:1080`), and its comment at l.1072-1079 says every host draws that one renderer, "header chip" included; the summary chip calls `formatPercent` directly instead.

reach: a render of `DetailView` with `{ name: 'probability', type: 'percent', percentDisplay: 'plain' }` named in `summaryFields`, value 0.4: the chip shows `40%` WITH a bar fill at 40%. CONTROL: the same field with no `percentDisplay` draws the bar (expected), and `PercentCellRenderer` with `plain` draws `40%` and no `[role="progressbar"]`. Run with vitest from `ui/` on a scratch test (not committed); 4 of 4 cases as stated. No example or `packages/apps` producer sets `percentDisplay` today (`git grep` empty).

## Done when
The chip's percent arm reads the merged field's `percentDisplay` (view over object, as its other reads do) and draws no bar for `plain`, for a percent field and for a formula whose `returnType` is `percent`. Pin both, with a CONTROL that an absent `percentDisplay` and `bar` still draw the bar, and the existing `summaryChip*` pins stay green.

## Business rationale
An author sets `percentDisplay: 'plain'` for a rate or a probability (a win probability, a margin) because a bar reads as progress. The list honours it; the first figure on the record page does not, so the same field reads as a rate in the list and as a progress bar beside the title. Reader: the area:data lane seat (seat 7, area d7-E), one small PR in `ui/packages/plugin-detail`.

Grade: p3 · area:data · Bug · record pages whose summaryFields name a percent field or formula set to plain, rare (no producer in the repo today) · evidence measured (render).
